mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day forward returns: lower FEDFUNDS levels predict positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is negative (or the Rank IC is below 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Federal Funds Rate above 0.5% (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals a tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of unemployment rate below 3.5% (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong labor force growth (PAYEMS > 150000) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by RSAFS > 600000 and HOUST > 1700), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS > 600000 and HOUST > 1700, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base), it signals a contraction in the supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP level (GDPC1) exceeds 19700 billion dollars, it signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 > 19700, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 280, it signals persistent high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 280, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1800 thousand units, it signals strong demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
